NeedDef.label: cache
NeedDef.description: Active processing buffer accumulated by this synthera's projected consciousness. As the avatar operates, it continuously generates data that fills the cache. When recalled to the altar, all accumulated cache is flushed cleanly back to core systems. If the buffer reaches capacity before recall, it overflows — the projection collapses abruptly and a recovery cycle is required before re-deployment. A Cache Purger nearby actively drains the buffer during active deployment, significantly extending continuous deployment time.
